glosses: Diviser (un marché, un bien…) en lots.
To distribute or apportion by (or as if by) lot.
To assign or designate as a task or for a purpose.

examples.text: Each candidate was allotted five minutes to make a presentation in front of the judges.

glosses: To divide and distribute portions of a whole.

examples.text: The controlling party had apportioned the voting districts such that their party would be favored in the next election.

glosses: Specifically, to do so in a fair and equitable manner; to allocate proportionally.

examples.text: The children were required to dump all of their Halloween candy on the table so that their parents could apportion it among them.
The Good Friday Agreement did not, and could not, apportion blame for the Troubles, in which, as in so many such conflicts, one side’s terrorist is the other’s hero.
